fields.label: base
fields.description: Base directory for relative root entries. Defaults to the host process cwd.

fields.label: root
fields.description: Comma-separated roots, resolved against base. Empty keeps the native extension/plugin roots.

fields.label: ignored
fields.description: Comma-separated globs excluded on top of .git and the module cache.

fields.label: debounce
fields.description: How long file changes are coalesced before one reload batch is emitted.
